worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.summary: Close in and press a brief kiss on the target; it heals you for a share of the damage actually dealt - the stickiest mouthful of the family.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.use.0: Sip a foe's breath back at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.use.1: Hold a low health line with one short kiss
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.descripti: Once the kiss lands it deals about %1$s Fairy contact damage and heals the user for %2$s of the damage actually dealt.
Its reach is only %1$s blocks: the user must truly press against the target, and a wall in between blocks the kiss.
The kiss must be held for %1$s to land; if the target pulls away, a wall comes between, or the action is interrupted, it simply misses.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.swoon.on: Swooning kiss: healing share x1.22, but power x0.88, 2 more ticks of contact and a longer cooldown - the sustain choice.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.swoon.off: Light peck: power x1.12, healing x0.9 and a faster press - the burst choice.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.timing: Cast on an enemy within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP; recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.growth.0: From level %1$s the kiss power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.growth.1: From level %1$s the kiss power rises to %2$s and the drain share to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.drainingkiss.preferenc: On: healing share x1.22, but power x0.88, contact +2 ticks and cooldown +5 - good for sustain. Off: power x1.12, healing x0.9 and a faster press - good for burst.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of reaching out to kiss. Larger chases a health line further.
Below this health ratio the user prefers draining kiss as sustain; higher leans on it for healing sooner.
